Location: Karachi
Description:

A Marine Superintendent (MSI) is sought for overseeing the marine, nautical, safety, security, and commercial operations of container, oil, or gas tanker vessels. Responsibilities include ensuring compliance with international maritime regulations, conducting vessel inspections, coordinating third-party inspections, and investigating incidents. A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and a minimum of 2 years of experience as a Marine or HSSQE Superintendent are required. Knowledge of SOLAS, MARPOL, ISM, ISPS, OCIMF, CDI, and RightShip standards is essential.
